Are TCB bear trap reviews bad? Investigate reputation, prices, and downtime

“Is TCB’s bear removal really effective?”

「9,800 yenWhat is the difference in cost between regeneration injections and dark circles removal that involves fat removal?

There may be many people who are wondering whether or not to undergo the treatment while having questions such as those mentioned above.

To catch a bear at TCB,Removal of sagging skin using regeneration injection, transconjunctival degreasing, and incision methodThere are multiple treatments available, and the treatment you should consider will differ depending on the condition under your eyes.

In this article, we will explain the points to keep in mind when checking reviews.Difference in price between regeneration injection and surgery of 9,800 yen, explains the progress of downtime.

In addition, we will introduce the causes of blue, brown, black, and mixed-type dark circles, as well as treatment options that you should check with your doctor.

Please use this information as a reference to determine whether TCB bear removal is suitable for you.

What you can learn from this article
  • Points to keep in mind when checking the reviews and reputation of TCB Bear Trap
  • Difference between the price of regeneration injection 9,800 yen and other dark circles removal treatments
  • Progress of downtime, recovery period and impact on daily life
Supervisor of this article

Yoshitomo Chihara

Director of Norris Beauty Clinic

Postdoctoral Researcher, Norris Cancer Center, University of Southern California;National Cancer Center PathologyHead of the club,Nara Prefectural Medical UniversityLecturer in Molecular Pathology,Saiseikai Chuwa HospitalAfter serving as head of the urology departmentnorris beauty clinicOpened a hospital.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

For detailed management structure and editorial stance, please seeNorris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicinePlease check.

Points to check when judging the reviews and reputation of TCB Bear Trap

When considering TCB bear removal, please refer to both good and bad reviews.Information that clearly states the treatment name, cost, and postoperative progressLet's check it out.

It is not possible to objectively judge the satisfaction rate or treatment effectiveness based on word of mouth alone, without confirming the source or case details.

Three perspectives when reading reviews of TCB Kuma Tori
  • Points to consider when checking reviews regarding finish
  • Points to note when reading reviews that say there is no effect or regrets
  • Points that differ in customer service/counseling responses

Causes of dark circles and indications for treatmentIt is important to separately check the preliminary explanation, total cost, and postoperative course.

Below, we will organize the items to check from three perspectives: finish, cost, and counseling.

Points to consider when checking reviews regarding finish

Reviews regarding the finish include:Symptom names such as blue bear and black bearIn addition, we will check to see if you can understand the actual treatment you received and your pre-surgery condition.

Blue circles are related to blood circulation and thin skin, so it is not always possible to improve them by removing fat.

On the other hand, in black bears where the protrusion of orbital fat creates a shadow,Transconjunctival degreasing methodetc. may be an option.

Before surgery, the doctor will explain the cause,Areas that can be improved with the proposed treatment and areas that may remainIt is important to understand.

Three conditions to check when evaluating the finish
  • There is an explanation of the causes of dark circles and treatment details.
  • My doctor explained the expected effects and limitations.
  • The timing of imaging and the postoperative course are shown.

If you see a post that says ``How many days after treatment,'' check to see if it indicates the type of treatment, degree of swelling, and when the photo was taken.

Blue bears and black bears have different causes, so even if you choose the same treatment, the effects may not be the same.

Downtime varies from person to person, so it is important not to base your schedule solely on cases that recover quickly.

Points to note when reading reviews that say there is no effect or regrets

When reading reviews that say “it didn’t work” or “I regret it”,Causes of dark circles and indications for treatmentLet's check if it matches.

brown bearBecause it is caused by melanin pigmentation, it may be difficult to make fundamental improvements using surgical procedures that treat fat.

In addition to injections, TCB also handles transconjunctival delipidation and incision methods, and degreasing alone may not be enough to treat dark circles that are mainly due to pigmentation.

Things to check when reading evaluations of “no effect/regrets”
  • Discrepancy between cause and treatment: When trying to deal with only fat removal even though pigmentation is the main problem
  • Misunderstanding of costs:If you believe that 9,800 yen will be applied to all treatments
  • Lack of understanding of progress: When downtime for each treatment was not differentiated

If you have dark circles or a mixed type, you need to check with your doctor to see if there are multiple causes, such as pigmentation, blood flow, or protruding fat.

When you consider that you can receive fat removal surgery for just 9,800 yen, there is a huge difference between the estimate and the estimate.

In the TCB official price list,Dark circles regeneration injection 9,800 yen, transconjunctival degreasing standard 83,600 yen, same procedure Supernatural 173,800 yenPrices vary depending on the treatment.

When considering complaints about downtime, it is important to distinguish between injections, degreasing, and skin excision procedures.

Points that differ in customer service/counseling responses

Customer service/counseling evaluation:Indicative of individual experienceTherefore, it is not a basis for uniformly determining the response of all hospitals.

When reading reviews, pay attention to the sufficiency of the explanation, the difference from the desired budget, the breakdown of the estimate, and whether there was time to consider the contract.

If you have any concerns about the hospital or the person in charge, you can check the explanation system and the doctor in charge before making a reservation.

Corresponding phrases that can be used on the day of counseling
  • “I will take it home and consider it” → You can express your intention to compare without signing a contract on the spot.
  • “Please let me know by comparing the benefits and costs of multiple plans” → Questions to elicit information
  • “These are the desired results and the upper limit of the budget.” → You can specifically communicate your desired conditions.

If you feel pressured into signing a contract on the day of your consultation, you can avoid making a decision on the spot by clearly communicating your intention to take it home and consider it.

There is no need to make an immediate decision on the day of your consultation.

If you are not satisfied, say, ``I will take it back and consider it.''

It is important to consult a doctor and compare the benefits, risks, and costs of multiple treatments before making a decision.

Please try to understand the type of bear you have before coming to the hospital, and let us know the desired result and the upper limit of your budget during the consultation.

Click here for details

Why is the price different between the 9,800 yen regeneration injection and other dark circles removal treatments?

Published on TCB9,800 yenThis is the price for dark circles removal injection, and is different from the price for procedures that involve fat removal or skin excision.

The difference in total cost is due to differences in the procedure itself, the proposed course, anesthesia, and other options.

Three reasons why the total cost of bear removal changes
  • How to check treatments for which 9,800 yen is applied and additional costs
  • Compare prices for regenerative injections, transconjunctival delipidation, and incision methods
  • Things to check to avoid being rushed into signing a contract on the day of counseling

To avoid feeling that the amount is not what you expected on the day of your counseling session,Understand the cost structure in advanceThat is important.

The price of 9,800 yen does not apply to all dark circles removal treatments, and the price will change if surgery is proposed depending on the symptoms.

Below, we will organize the applicable menu of 9,800 yen, main treatment fees, and items to confirm during counseling.

How to check treatments for which 9,800 yen is applied and additional costs

9,800 yen is listed on the TCB official price list.Tax-included price for dark circles regeneration injectionIt is.

Be sure to check the treatments covered by the 9,800 yen fee and the actual total payment amount before making a reservation or at the time of counseling.

The required number of injections varies depending on the symptoms and treatment details, so please confirm the total amount required for multiple regeneration injections at the time of your consultation.

If protruding fat or sagging skin is noticeable, other treatments such as transconjunctival degreasing or incision may be suggested.

If you are offered another treatment, please check the reason for it and the total cost.

You can also take it home and compare it without making a decision on the spot.

Be sure to check the breakdown of your quote, as additional options such as anesthesia may have additional charges.

Change of treatment, multiple injections, addition of optionsThe total payment amount may change depending on the amount.

Compare prices for regenerative injections, transconjunctival delipidation, and incision methods

TCB's main methods of removing bears include:Dark circles removal injection, dark circles removal without cutting the skin (transconjunctival degreasing method), under-eye bags removal using incision methodThere is.

Dark bear removal regeneration injection9,800 yen, A separate menu for bear removal regeneration injection premium (Sunekosu injection)1cc 69,800 yen, 3 times 189,000 yenas stated in the official price list.

How to remove dark circles without cutting the skin (transconjunctival degreasing method)Standard 83,600 yen, Supernatural 173,800 yen, Perfect 297,000 yen, Excellent 458,000 yenIt is.

Removal of bags under the eyes by incision (lower eyelid wrinkle removal)83,600～547,800 yenThis is a different treatment from the transconjunctival degreasing method.

*These are free medical treatments, and swelling, internal bleeding, and pain may occur.

*Prices are the officially published tax-inclusive prices confirmed on October 13, 2026.

The latest rates and applicable conditions areTCB official price listPlease check.

TCB does not charge a counseling fee, so you can make a decision after checking the indications and estimate for the treatment.

Injection is used for blue and brown bears, and degreasing is used for black bears due to protruding fat.may be considered, but suitability will be determined by examination.

If you go into counseling after understanding the type of bear you have in advance, it will be easier to judge the validity of the proposal.

Things to check to avoid being rushed into signing a contract on the day of counseling

On the day of your counseling session, be prepared to make decisions calmly and not be influenced by the atmosphere.

During counseling, we will explain the applicable fee menu, reason for recommended treatment, breakdown of total cost, required number of treatments, and downtime.5 pointsLet's check.

STEP①
Check the cause of dark circles and the prospects for improvement

Check specifically whether your bear is blue, brown, black, or mixed, and how much improvement you can expect with the proposed plan.

STEP②
Ask if there are any additional costs and the estimated amount.

Check the existence and approximate amount of any expenses that may be incurred in addition to the advertised price (anesthesia fees, aftercare fees, re-examination fees, etc.).

STEP③
Express your intention to take it home and consider it.

If you are asked to make an immediate decision on the same day, say, ``I'll take it home and consider it,'' and sign the contract once you're satisfied.

5 things to check on the day of counseling
  • Treatments eligible for 9,800 yen and applicable conditions
  • Reasons for recommended plans (why the plan is suitable for you)
  • Breakdown of total amount (confirm treatment fee, anesthesia fee, and aftercare fee in writing)
  • Approximate number of treatments (will it be completed in one session or will it need multiple sessions?)
  • Downtime period (impact on work/daily life)

When a treatment is recommended,I would like to take it home and consider it.Let's clearly convey our intentions.

If you are advised of same-day rates, etc., please confirm the applicable conditions and total payment amount in writing, and consider the necessity of a contract.

Regarding the breakdown of the total amount, we will separate the treatment fee, anesthesia fee, and aftercare fee.presented in writingI recommend that you do so.

Confirm the amount in writing, as verbal explanations alone can easily lead to misunderstandings later.

Consulting is viewed as a place to gather information, and going into it without assuming a contract on the day will lead to a choice you will not regret.

Downtime period of TCB bear removal and progress after treatment

Swelling and internal bleeding may occur after TCB dark circles removal treatment.downtimeAfter this process, the finish will gradually become stable.

TCB advises that downtime varies depending on the procedure, with regenerative injections causing swelling, pain, and internal bleeding for about 2 days, and transconjunctival delipidation requiring swelling and internal bleeding for about 1 to 2 weeks.

Estimated progress and recovery period depending on the treatment type
  • Swelling and internal bleeding for 1 to 2 weeks immediately after the procedure
  • Recovery course by treatment and impact on daily life
  • Actions to avoid to avoid prolonging downtime

Questions such as ``Will I be able to return to work immediately after the treatment'' and ``How long will it take before I can go out in public'' are essential criteria when considering treatment.

Below, we will explain recovery guidelines and precautions, focusing on the transconjunctival delipidation method.

Swelling and internal bleeding for 1 to 2 weeks immediately after the procedure

Swelling and internal bleeding may occur for a few days immediately after the procedure.

With transconjunctival degreasing, swelling and internal bleeding may last for about 1 to 2 weeks, and the intensity of symptoms varies from person to person.

The color of internal bleeding and how to reduce swelling vary from person to person, so TCB will guide you.About 1-2 weeksPlease check the progress based on the following.

TCB's official guideline for regeneration injections is that swelling, pain, and internal bleeding will take about 2 days, but the progress varies from person to person.

Please refrain from drinking alcohol until the swelling has subsided, and follow the instructions for the treatment you received regarding restrictions such as exercise and bathing.

If the area of internal bleeding rapidly spreads the day after the treatment, or if you are accompanied by fever or strong pain, please contact the clinic immediately as there may be a risk of infection.

It is often possible to cover internal bleeding with concealer, but applying it directly to the wound isdoctor's permissionLet's do it after it comes down.

Recovery course by treatment and impact on daily life

Swelling and internal bleeding after transconjunctival delipidation are expected to occur within 1 to 2 weeks, but recovery time varies from person to person.

TCB provides a guideline for completion of transconjunctival degreasing.About 1 month, removing slack by incision methodAbout 3 monthsI am guiding you.

After about two weeks, the swelling may subside, but the area under the eyes may feel hard and uncomfortable.

If the hardness or discomfort is strong or lasts for a long time, do not assume that it is normal and consult your doctor.

The timing of returning to work varies depending on the treatment, severity of symptoms, and type of job.Possibility of continued swelling and internal bleedingPlease adjust your schedule accordingly.

Do not make any decisions about the finished product before the completion date, and if you have any symptoms that concern you, please check with your doctor about the progress.

The time required for completion is different for the transconjunctival degreasing method and the incision method, so be sure to check the guidance for each treatment name.

Actions to avoid to avoid prolonging downtime

The course after the surgery depends on the treatment details and your physical condition, so please be sure to follow the precautions in your daily life.

Activities that increase circulation, such as drinking alcohol or strenuous exercise, can affect swelling, so follow your doctor's instructions.

Avoid drinking, strenuous exercise, long baths, and saunas for a few days after your treatment, and check with your doctor when to resume treatment.

Behavioral restrictions to check with your doctor after surgery
  • Drinking alcohol (for transconjunctival degreasing, refrain from drinking until the swelling has subsided)
  • Intense exercise (check with your doctor when to resume)
  • Long bathing/sauna (follow instructions for each treatment)
  • Rubbing/pressing the treatment area (for transconjunctival degreasing, refrain from rubbing/pushing for about a month)
  • Massaging the treatment area without the doctor's permission

TCB advises that you can take transconjunctival degreasing baths and showers on the same day, but please check separately for restrictions on long baths, saunas, etc.

After transconjunctival degreasing, follow the TCB instructions andAbout 1 monthAvoid rubbing or pressing your eyes too hard.

Do not massage the treatment area on your own without your doctor's permission.

This may place stress on the tissues that are in the process of recovery and affect the final result.

Ultraviolet rays can also cause pigmentation after surgery, so please protect your under-eye area with UV-blocking sunglasses and sunscreen when going out.

Please check the post-surgery precautions provided by the clinic and consult your doctor if you have any questions.

How to consider TCB treatment for each type of bear

If you undergo treatment without properly understanding the type of dark circles, you will not be able to get the treatment even if it is expensive.Expected effectmay not be obtained.

Dark circles under the eyes depend on the main causeBlue bear, brown bear, black bearThere is also a mixed type, where the causes overlap.

Examples of treatments that can be considered by type of bear
  • For blue and brown bears, regeneration injections may be considered.
  • Transconjunctival degreasing is an option for dark circles caused by fat protrusion.
